free_text: The patient is a 69-year-old male with a high PSA of 12.6 and a biopsy-proven adenocarcinoma with ISUP grade group 1. MRI shows a PI-RADS 5 lesion (cT1c) with restricted diffusion, but no extracapsular extension. The competing illness is prostate cancer. Management assessment is active surveillance, balancing potential treatment benefit against patient preferences.
